nodes.label: Use React DOM Resource Hints
nodes.rationale: react-dom exposes prefetchDNS, preconnect, preload, preloadModule, preinit and preinitModule so the browser starts DNS/TCP/TLS and resource fetches early; calling them from server components begins the work before the client even receives the HTML. Each hint is matched to a case: prefetchDNS for later third-party domains, preconnect for immediate APIs/CDNs, preload for current-page critical fonts and styles, preloadModule for likely next navigation, preinit/preinitModule for code that must execute early. Impact HIGH.
